Thanks again for the intro earlier — HelixPay would love a hands-on walkthrough of Redwood next Thursday. Our core asks: low-latency routing across regions, private deployment options, and a quick look at observability.

Hi Sarah — great to hear. Thanks for the attendee list and the agenda.

Quick note: Karthik (our SE) is listed as available but he's in transit that afternoon and has an overlapping executive alignment meeting that may conflict with the proposed windows. I don't want to risk a half-attended technical demo. Two options that usually work:

- Option A: Do a concise 30-minute live product demo focused on the architecture and routing (Vanessa + Karthik joins for the critical first 20 mins, might drop at the end of his transit), followed by a recorded deep-dive (30–40 mins) we send within 24 hours.
- Option B: Marcus (Solutions Engineer) runs the full 60-minute session on behalf of the SE team; Karthik does a 1:1 technical follow-up after travel.

If you prefer Option A, we can propose slots: Thu Nov 26 at 11:00 AM ET or 1:00 PM ET (both 30-minute windows). If Option B, Marcus is free at 10:30 AM ET or 2:00 PM ET for a 60-minute block.

Let me know which you prefer and I will send the calendar invite + updated agenda.

Regards,
Vanessa Ortiz
